# A small goal: white square posts and crossbar (0.1 m) 3.2 x 1.5 m, a box net 0.9 m deep made of
# alpha-masked panels (textures/net_*.png, 0.3 m cells). Origin on the centre of the goal line, the
# mouth facing -Y (the GLB's +Z: yaw +-90 in the scene). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Frame --base-color 1.000 1.000 1.000 --no-slot
material new NetBack --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture NetBack base-color textures/net_back.png
material set NetBack alpha-mode mask
material set NetBack alpha-cutoff 0.5
material new NetSide --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture NetSide base-color textures/net_side.png
material set NetSide alpha-mode mask
material set NetSide alpha-cutoff 0.5
material new NetTop --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture NetTop base-color textures/net_top.png
material set NetTop alpha-mode mask
material set NetTop alpha-cutoff 0.5
add mesh cube --name PostL --size 1 --location -1.600 0.000 0.775
scale 0.100 0.100 1.550
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name PostR --size 1 --location 1.600 0.000 0.775
scale 0.100 0.100 1.550
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Bar --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 1.500
scale 3.300 0.100 0.100
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name BackL --size 1 --location -1.600 0.900 0.750
scale 0.060 0.060 1.500
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name BackR --size 1 --location 1.600 0.900 0.750
scale 0.060 0.060 1.500
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name BackBar --size 1 --location 0.000 0.900 1.470
scale 3.200 0.060 0.060
apply --scale
select PostL PostR Bar BackL BackR BackBar
material assign Frame
add mesh plane --name NBack --size 1 --location 0.000 0.900 0.750
scale 3.200 1.500 1
apply --scale
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign NetBack
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view back --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh plane --name NSideL --size 1 --location -1.600 0.450 0.750
scale 0.900 1.500 1
apply --scale
set rotation 90 0 90
apply --rotation
material assign NetSide
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view right --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh plane --name NSideR --size 1 --location 1.600 0.450 0.750
scale 0.900 1.500 1
apply --scale
set rotation 90 0 90
apply --rotation
material assign NetSide
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view right --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh plane --name NTop --size 1 --location 0.000 0.450 1.480
scale 3.200 0.900 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign NetTop
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
select all
active PostL
join
rename PostL Goal
cursor set 0 0 0
origin set --to cursor
shade flat
export goal.glb
